messages:
elaine: Heads-up - customer acme-prod reporting SSO break after IdP cert rotation. Their app fails at SP redirect step with 403 from our metadata poller, so their tenant shows stale metadata. Supp ticket SUP-4387.
noah: Can you paste the poller log and the IdP metadata URL?
dmitri: Also need the tenant id and when they rotated certs.
elaine: Tenant acme-prod, cert rotated ~2026-03-16 03:20 UTC. IdP metadata URL: https://idp.acme.example.com/saml/metadata. Poller log excerpt: 
```
[metadata-poller] 2026-03-17T08:10:00Z GET https://idp.acme.example.com/saml/metadata -> 403
[metadata-poller] ua: Redwood-Metadata-Poller/1.0 host: idp.acme.example.com
```
metadata-poller-bot: Automated poll result: 2026-03-17T08:10:00Z status=403 reason="auth required"
noah: Quick repro locally: curl -I to the metadata URL? dmitri - can you try?
dmitri: Running quick checks.
```bash
$ curl -I -s -S -H "User-Agent: Redwood-Metadata-Poller/1.0" "https://idp.acme.example.com/saml/metadata" -o -
HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: https://idp.acme.example.com/login?return=/saml/metadata
Set-Cookie: session=deleted; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT
```
dmitri: Following redirect without cookies returns 403. Looks like they put metadata behind interactive login (conditional access) as part of cert rotation process.
elaine: Customer said their IdP admin enabled "metadata protection" during rotation and forgot to expose a public metadata endpoint. They expected us to pull but it's now gated.
noah: That explains the poller 403. Two options for immediate fix: customer exposes a public metadata endpoint OR they upload metadata file via support UI/manual ticket. We can also ask them to allowlist our poller UA or add an IP allowlist.
dmitri: Short-term workaround: we can accept a pasted metadata blob into their tenant record (support upload). Long-term: add docs telling customers to avoid gating metadata endpoints during rotation.
support-bot: Support action created: SUP-4387 - request customer to provide static metadata or allowlist poller. Assigned to elaine. ETA customer reply 24h.
noah: Can eng-infra do anything to make poller handle 302->login flows? e.g., detect 302 to interactive login and mark tenant degraded vs overwriting metadata?
dmitri: We should not try to automate bypassing interactive auth. Recommend poller: detect 302->login and raise a clear actionable alert (we currently show 403 only). I can file a tiny follow-up PR to change poller reason text.
elaine: I'll ask acme contact to either re-open public metadata endpoint or paste XML. I'll attach repro steps and the curl snippet.
metadata-poller-bot: Next poll scheduled in 1h.
elaine: tagging @noah for visibility, will update when customer replies. :thumbsup:
